newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss money rates steady, seen easing further.
newsitem.headline: Swiss money rates steady, seen easing further.

text.p: 0815 GMT - Swiss money market rates were steady and expected to ease further next week as dealers see the recent brief period of tightening -- largely technical in nature -- as over.
The Swiss National Bank (SNB) also offered short-term money at 1-1/2 percent this morning in its fine-tuning operations, in line with market rates.
Tomorrow/next was quoted at 1.50/1.75 pct in the market.
Short-term rates are expected to ease further to between 1.00 and 1.50 percent next week, a range that is seen more in line with the SNB's monetary policy intensions.
